# Lint rules

Every write runs these rules (todo17 D4). Severities: **error** rejects the write, **warn** saves it and returns a finding, **info** records it, **off** skips it. Projects override severities per code in `rules.severityOverrides`. Rules in **evaluate** mode record findings as if enforced but reject nothing (D5).

| Code | Applies to | Default | Mode | Auto-fix | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label.unknown` | annotation | error | enforce | no | Label isn't in the project's rules. Use one of the labels in the project rules (see `allowed`), or propose a rules change that adds it. |
| `label.synonym` | annotation | info | enforce | yes | Label is a synonym of a canonical label. Use the canonical label name; the normaliser rewrites synonyms on write. |
| `geometry.not-allowed` | annotation | error | enforce | no | Geometry not allowed for this label. Draw this label with one of its allowed geometries (see `allowed`). |
| `label.in-use` | rules | error | enforce | no | Rules change would orphan annotations. Merge the label into another with labels.merge (or rename it with labels.rename) instead of removing it; the message gives the count. |
| `label.name-taken` | rules | error | enforce | no | Rename target is already a label. Merge into the existing label with labels.merge instead of renaming onto it. |
| `annotation.out-of-bounds` | annotation | error | evaluate | yes | Annotation lies outside the image. Keep the geometry inside the image extent; clip it or redraw it. |
| `annotation.too-small` | annotation | warn | evaluate | no | Annotation is smaller than the minimum size. Redraw it at least `annotations.minSize` across, or delete it if it was a stray click. |
| `annotation.attribute-missing` | annotation | error | evaluate | no | Required attribute missing. Set every attribute listed in `annotations.requiredAttributes` and the label's attribute schema. |
| `dataset.name-taken` | dataset | error | enforce | no | Dataset name already used in this project. Pick another name, or add the files to the existing dataset. |
| `dataset.metadata-missing` | dataset | error | evaluate | no | Required dataset metadata missing. Fill in every field in `datasets.requiredMetadata` (modality, license, source, description). |
| `dataset.mixed-modality` | dataset, file | warn | evaluate | no | Dataset mixes modalities. Put each modality in its own dataset. |
| `layout.misplaced` | file | warn | evaluate | no | File is outside the project's folder layout. Move the file under one of `layout.folderPatterns`, within `layout.maxDepth`. |
| `layout.forbidden-char` | file | error | enforce | yes | Path contains forbidden characters. Remove the characters listed in `layout.forbiddenCharacters` from the path. |
| `layout.too-deep` | file | warn | evaluate | no | Path is deeper than the layout allows. Use a shallower folder, within `layout.maxDepth`. |
| `name.pattern` | file, dataset | warn | evaluate | yes | Name doesn't match the naming rules. Rename it to match `layout.fileNamePattern` without `layout.forbiddenCharacters`; trimming and NFC are applied on write. |
| `name.phi-suspect` | file, dataset | error | evaluate | no | Name may contain personal health information. Rename it with a pseudonymous id; never use patient names, dates of birth or record numbers. |
| `env.unresolved` | environment | error | enforce | no | Environment doesn't resolve. Fix the references the resolver reports (modules, renderers, tools) using the catalogue. |
| `env.label-drift` | environment | warn | evaluate | yes | Studio labels differ from the project's rules. Use the project's labels in the Studio, or propose a rules change. |
| `dicom.series-incomplete` | dicom | warn | evaluate | no | DICOM series is incomplete. Upload the missing instances (see the slice gaps), or remove the partial series. |
| `dicom.seg-frame-mismatch` | dicom | error | evaluate | no | SEG frame of reference doesn't match its source. Regenerate the segmentation against the referenced series. |
| `nifti.orientation-mismatch` | nifti | warn | evaluate | no | NIfTI qform and sform disagree. Rewrite the header with one consistent affine (qform = sform). |
